public_browser.note: setup.sh builds this source and generates a fresh Agent profile/MCP entry. No source browser state or credentials exported; workstation.json is authoritative.

pi.note: setup.sh installs through node-tools/package-lock.json. A new MCP entry is generated; no source settings, providers, history or authentication copied.

external_packages.note: setup.sh installs these using the signed repositories and primary fingerprints in workstation.json. No source APT auth, tunnel credentials or browser databases are imported.

other_local_tools.note: Inventory/checklist only, not portable artifacts. Verify origin, version, checksum and licensing before installing. Proprietary software and licenses must be obtained legitimately, not copied from this machine.
